decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to rapidly deploy threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Delver of Secrets, backed up by disruptive countermagic like Daze and Force of Will. The goal is to apply pressure to the opponent while disrupting their game plan, all while efficiently filtering through the deck with cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with plenty of red sources for Lightning Bolt and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main concept of this deck is to play aggressively with low-cost and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, and generate card advantage with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base includes land destruction with Wasteland and efficient fetch lands to ensure consistent mana fixing. The deck overall focuses on tempo plays to stay ahead of the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. Emry, Lurker of the Loch provides card advantage and recursion while Thought Monitor and Urza's Saga help generate mana and/or find combo pieces. Force of Will offers protection, while cards like Metallic Rebuke and Mishra's Bauble provide additional utility and synergy. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately leading to a win through mill rather than traditional damage.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The key strategy is to maintain control of the game tempo by efficiently removing threats with Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out, while also drawing into more threats and answers with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Wasteland to disrupt opponent's mana bases. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to generate card advantage and create a board presence quickly. By combining cheap artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal with powerful artifact creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an army of creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void. Additionally, Urza's Saga provides additional utility by tutoring for key artifacts and lands to further solidify the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Leyline of the Void, and Opposition Agent, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Plague Engineer. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption, while Helm of Obedience can serve as a win condition. The deck aims to control the board with removal and disruption, while efficiently deploying threats to quickly close out the game. The mana base is streamlined for consistency and speed, focusing on early game aggression.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo, using cards like Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to mill the library, while also utilizing Baleful Strix and Thassa's Oracle to manipulate and win the game. The deck also includes various control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, alongside card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Aether Vial adds additional consistency and flexibility to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then using spells like Reanimate and Shallow Grave to bring them back into play for a devastating combo. The deck also includes cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting to efficiently set up the combo, while disruption cards like Cabal Therapy and Unmask help protect the key combo pieces. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, explosive plays that can win the game in just a few turns.

This Doomsday combo deck focuses on quickly assembling the necessary cards to cause a game-winning sequence of actions, ultimately leading to a victory through Thassa's Oracle. By utilizing cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Personal Tutor to set up a perfect Doomsday pile, the deck aims to control the game early on with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize. With careful planning and precise execution, this deck can effectively manipulate the top of the library and secure a win through a well-orchestrated series of plays.

The main concept of this deck is to use cheap equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly power up creatures like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic. The goal is to assemble a powerful creature equipped with multiple artifacts to deal massive damage to the opponent in a short amount of time. The deck also includes ways to protect the creatures, such as Swords to Plowshares and Sigarda's Aid, while ramping up with cards like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive combo strategy.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent by playing efficient creatures and disrupting their game plan. By utilizing aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game and close out the match as quickly as possible. Additionally, cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide help ramp out threats ahead of schedule, giving this deck the advantage in the early game.

The primary focus of this aggro Legacy deck is to quickly establish board presence and control through powerful creatures such as Archon of Emeria and Palace Jailer. The deck utilizes mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox to get ahead of opponents and disrupt their game plan with cards like Swords to Plowshares. The inclusion of cards like Ephemerate and Once Upon a Time allow for flexibility and consistency in drawing key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder to slow down the opponent, while deploying threats like Archon of Emeria and Solitude to pressure them, the deck aims to maintain control of the board and dictate the pace of the game. With the help of mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, the deck can quickly deploy its threats and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to recover.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. This is achieved by using cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to assemble the combo pieces quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Red Elemental Blast, Pyroblast, and Lightning Bolt to control the board and protect the combo. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and mana ramp, while cards like Phyrexian Dragon Engine and Chaos Defiler offer alternate win conditions. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent through efficient creatures and burn spells, while disrupting their game plan with counter spells and land destruction. It aims to control the game tempo by efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately winning through repeated attacks and burn damage. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to adapt to different matchups and maintain a strong presence on the battlefield while disrupting the opponent's plans. It leverages powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, along with versatile spells like Brainstorm and Lightning Bolt, to maintain board advantage and pressure the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by playing efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes a lot of card selection with spells like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration to ensure drawing into the right cards at the right time. Additionally, the deck runs a few removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with opposing threats. Utilizing the deck's fast mana base with Wasteland and fetchlands allows for a consistent and aggressive playstyle.
